[[File:Monkey Zombie chathead.png|left]]
'''Monkey Zombies''' are encountered during [[Monkey Madness I]] in the [[Ape Atoll Dungeon]] and [[Temple of Marimbo Dungeon]]. They drop [[monkey bones]] that are needed to make a [[zombie greegree]]. They appear to be green undead monkeys.

These monsters can be used for [[Ranged]] training, with high enough [[Prayer]] and combat levels, at about 100,000 experience per hour at higher levels. [[Protect from Melee]], and restore on the altar to the north-west above the dungeon. Equip a [[greegree]] prior to completing [[Monkey Madness II]] or the [[Monkey guard]]s may attack after going up the ladder. Alternatively bring [[Prayer equipment]] and use [[prayer potion]]s. [[Salve amulet]]s and the [[salve amulet (e)|enchanted version]] work against them as they are [[undead (attribute)|undead]].

The level 98 monkey zombies can only be found in the room with the [[monkey skull]] in the Temple of Marimbo Dungeon, requiring completion of the [[Hard Western Provinces Diary]].
